$comment: Test files under scripts/tests/ or scripts/ci/tests/ that no CI workflow
every *.test.{mjs,ts,sh} file directly under those two directories must be
wired into a `run:` step in .github/workflows/ or listed here.
kind 'cannot-run-in-ci' = needs a database, the VPS, a live external site,
or a credential CI does not have. kind 'broken' = cannot currently run or
pass anywhere; it needs a tracking issue, because a broken test hiding
inside 'excluded' is exactly the silence this gate exists to end
Paths must name one file exactly, under scripts/tests/ or scripts/ci/tests/

exclusions.reason: The self-test is a real defect finder, not a broken test: audit-ipo-coverage.mjs's subRows SELECT is missing face_value, authoritative_issue_price and company_website, which three SUBSTANCE_CHECKS predicates read — those predicates silently no-op on every row today. Wiring this into CI now would fail every PR on a pre-existing production defect it did not cause. Excluded until the SELECT is fixed (issue #1173), then it wires in as a normal pass.

Needs a live DB and, on a database built from the migration journal in CI, reports real COLUMN_TYPE_MISMATCH drift (gmp_records numeric columns numeric(32,0) vs schema.ts numeric(10,2); listing_performance.current_gain_percent numeric(5,2) vs numeric(7,2)). Wiring it now fails every PR on a pre-existing schema/migration defect it did not cause; wire it once #1176 aligns the two.

Two cases fail on the CI runner (DB exactly at / ahead of the newest journaled migration exit 1 instead of 0) while the rest pass; either a real bug in this deploy gate or a CI fixture gap, to be settled in #1177 before it is wired.

One of 56 cases (LIVE --new-only baseline run writing issues-sync-state.json) fails on the CI runner, most likely an environment dependency; excluded until #1178 fixes the test or the code path, then it wires in as a normal pass.

Three cases fail on the CI runner through git subprocesses (execSync) against the real tree while passing locally with a full checkout; likely shallow checkout / git identity on the runner. Excluded until #1181 fixes the test setup or the job checkout depth.

Case 24 fails on the runner with ENOENT: a planted build-card fixture path is resolved against the process cwd instead of the repo root given as argv[2] - a real root-resolution defect to fix in #1182 before wiring.
